meta.variance_coordinates: offline full-sequence keys, including future positions
meta.independent_unit: source sequence/document; queries and layers are repeated measurements
meta.full192: logit proxy, not mass oracle; no output quality or speed claim
meta.caliber: per-head softmax -> 16-head mean prob (O1 group-mean analog); single shared selection on head-mean score (MLA latent-shared index story); L1 page-avg top-K1 -> L2 token top-768; ref = head-mean prob TopK-768
meta.rope_layout: halves after official even/odd rearrangement: dim j (0..31) = cos component of frequency pair j, dim j+32 = sin of pair j; omega_j = inv_freq[j] decreasing in j; yarn factor 40 keeps j<=10 at original frequency, /40 for j>=23 (near-constant over 16K); lowfreq32 = pairs 16..31 = dims {16..31}u{48..63}, highfreq32 = pairs 0..15 = dims {0..15}u{32..47}; derivation in exp/trace/e158_math_design.md section 2.3

arms.rope64: anchor: rope only (E141b best single component)

arms.rope64_nope32f: hypothesis 5 budget: rope 64 + nope first 32 = 96 dims
arms.lofreq32_nope32f: e158c hypothesis 6 budget: rope lowfreq 32 + nope first 32 = 64 dims
arms.lofreq32_nope32hi: e158c hypothesis 6 budget: rope lowfreq 32 + nope variance-top 32 = 64 dims
